result.summary: Found 2 visually suspicious issues: one likely stuck image load state and one layout overlap at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' card shows a loading spinner over the artwork, which makes it look like the image is stuck loading or failed to render.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image source and loading state; replace the spinner with the actual image once loaded, or show a proper fallback/placeholder if the asset fails.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the content list, cutting off the next restaurant card so its lower portion is hidden behind the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scrollable content so cards are fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
